title: "No matter how much we resist, we are all bound to say 'if only' at some point."
text:
"No matter how much we resist, we are all bound to say 'if only' at some point."

— From "Sir" (The Secret) by Fatih Duman

A simple yet profound reminder: regret is part of the human experience. The real question is — are we reading, learning, and growing enough today to minimize tomorrow's "if onlys"?

#Mutolaa #Books #Reading #Wisdom #PersonalGrowth
